category_edits.rationale: Expose repeated preferences by scaling each input item vector by 1 + 0.1 * min(log1p(c), 2), where c counts matching nonpadding items strictly earlier in the supplied causal sequence. This adds no learned parameters and preserves the SASRec backbone, readout, loss and optimizer. The generated predictor imports this same SASRec class, so training and inference use identical features without checkpoint changes.
